# proxmox_storage_contents (Data Source)

Lists volume content of one storage on a node from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content`, sorted by volume id. `content` filters by Proxmox content type (for example `iso` or `backup`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_contents" "iso" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  storage = "local"
  content = "iso"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Node whose storage view is used.
- `storage` (String) Storage to list.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Restrict to one content type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<storage>[/<content>]` form.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) Volumes sorted by `volid`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String)
- `ctime` (Number)
- `encrypted` (String)
- `format` (String)
- `notes` (String)
- `protected` (Boolean)
- `size` (Number)
- `verification` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)
- `volid` (String)
